output.notes: Described the decoder block of the base configuration (primary); big differs only in sizes (Table 3 bottom row) and is the headline 28.4 BLEU model. Vocab left not_stated: EN-DE is 'about 37000' shared BPE tokens, EN-FR 32000 word-pieces (task-dependent). Context length, LayerNorm eps and q/k/v/head biases not stated. Big head_dim 64 taken from base row via 'Unlisted values are identical to those of the base model'. The parsing model (4 layers, d_model 1024) and AOP variants are not the headline model. n_kv_heads equals n_heads because each head has its own W^K_i, W^V_i.
